name: Atoms, molecules, ions and naming

name: Particles, states of matter and KMT
description: Kinetic molecular theory, intermolecular forces, pressure, temperature as average kinetic energy, solids/liquids/gases.

name: Mixtures, pure substances and separations
description: Homogeneous vs heterogeneous mixtures, elements vs compounds, physical vs chemical properties and changes, filtration, evaporation, magnetism, chromatography.

name: Temperature scales
description: Celsius, Kelvin and Fahrenheit conversions; Kelvin as the absolute scale.

name: SI units, prefixes and taking measurements
description: SI base units, metric prefixes (G, M, k, c, m, micro, n, p), reading instruments to one estimated digit.

name: Accuracy, precision, percent yield and percent error
description: Accuracy vs precision of data sets, random error, percent yield = experimental/theoretical, percent error = |experimental - accepted|/accepted.

name: Scientific notation
description: Converting to and from scientific notation, multiplying and dividing powers of ten, reality-checking answers.

name: Significant figures and rounding
description: Counting sig figs (Pacific-Atlantic rule), rounding, add/subtract by decimal places, multiply/divide by fewest sig figs.

name: Dimensional analysis
description: Unit conversions with conversion factors, metric conversions, derived units (speed, density) as conversion factors, squared and cubed units, converting two units at once.

name: Density
description: Density = mass/volume, using density as a conversion factor, comparing densities, unit changes (g/cm3 to kg/m3).
